title: The shifted bare-energy normal form and adapted radius close under the primitive spectral budget

primitive_composition.shifted_normal_form: Put q_(sigma,k)=k-sigma e a_infinity and define E_infinity with |q_(sigma,k)|^2. Repeating K1598 with tilde a=a-a_infinity gives exactly E_infinity=H_a+e tilde a dot D_infinity-(e^2/2)|tilde a|^2M and E_infinity'=e tilde a dot D_infinity'-(e^2/2)|tilde a|^2M'.
primitive_composition.bare_energy: The same mass estimate gives |E_infinity'|<=[2|e||tilde a|+(e^2/m)|tilde a|^2]E_infinity. With B_a=B_G0+B_G2 and B_a2=B_G0 B_a, E_infinity(t)<=E_infinity(0)exp(2|e|B_a+(e^2/m)B_a2).
primitive_composition.adapted_radius: Assume the harmonic-adapted hierarchy has B_A(t)<=|e||tilde a(t)|+R(t), with B_R=int R<infinity. K1573 then gives rho_infinity>=rho_0-(C_m/4)(|e|B_a+B_R).
primitive_composition.positive_budget: The explicit condition (C_m/4)(|e|(B_G0+B_G2)+B_R)<rho_0 preserves a positive limiting analytic radius while arbitrary static a_infinity is absorbed into the reference covariant energy.
primitive_composition.scope_guard: This is conditional on the atom-free primitive representation, the adapted hierarchy, and integrable nonlinear remainder R. It proves neither E_h in L1 nor nonlinear/source-owned global dynamics, coercivity, physical quotient or continuation.
